breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflicting instructions. The original prompt incorrectly listed both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' method. The ground truth correctly removes the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction, leaving only the detailed Strang splitting. The agent, however, attempted to merge the two conflicting instructions by stating 'Use an explicit forward Euler time integration scheme with Strang splitting', which is nonsensical and perpetuates the original error instead of correcting it.
